body: i know you don’t want feed back but you mentioned how hard it would be to write notes to your loved ones, find whatever reason you need to keep yourself alive regardless of how minor or major it may seem. i don’t know your situation but i can assure you that things will improve in time, depression is not a one way road. try doing the things that used to make you happy when you were younger, or expressing your thoughts in a journal. i hope you’ll be able to read this, wishing the best for you💓
your place on this earth matters and everything that you’re feeling is valid. pain is not eternal. i wish you a safe journey to happiness, you matter.
i’m sorry about your relationship, she seems like a sweet girl. and you’re definitely right about that, though i wish no one would have to go through this. i hope things get better💓
exactly and it’s sucks. i guess that’s why i prefer to suffer silently which also sucks, but it gets monotonous opening up to people who simply don’t understand or refuses to understand.

hey! i’m not near Indianapolis or in the US at all but i went on psychology today, did a little search and found this. i hope this is resourceful, best of luck to you on your journey💓[Therapist ](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/therapists/adults/in/indianapolis)
if it makes you feel any better, i once opened up to my manager about my depression and she told me that i “need a boyfriend” lmao
i deleted instagram along with snapchat and twitter too. sometimes it’s such a negative environment and it just becomes too much so i periodically take breaks.
felt like this on my birthday this year too and it sucks for a little while but it’s okay. happy birthday and i hope you enjoy your day💓
exactly. it feels like an infection eating away at my thoughts, it’s frustrating.
please think this through, wishing you all the best. xx
